posts.title: Mistral raises €3B as sovereign AI becomes big business
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 8): French lab closed a €3B Series D at a €21B valuation led by Samsung, Scaleup Europe and PSG Equity — framed as sovereign/open-weight AI becoming big business.

posts.title: Mistral AI raises 3 billion euros in Europe's largest-ever tech funding round despite lagging behind rivals
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 8): €3B Series D pushes valuation past €21B (~$24B) — billed as Europe's largest private-tech equity round — Samsung/EQT Scaleup/PSG co-leads, even as models still trail US frontier rivals.

posts.title: Mistral raises €3B
posts.summary: Prismix/HN (Sep 8): Front-page cluster on Mistral's sovereign open-weight raise and company post — same €3B Series D / ~€21B valuation story as Decoder/TC.

posts.title: Nvidia-backed Firmus signs deal with OpenAI for Malaysia data centre capacity
posts.summary: Reuters (Sep 8): Australia's Firmus signed a multi-year deal to supply OpenAI compute from two Malaysian data centres; contracted capacity now >900MW; Vera Rubin planned at scale; Firmus valued >$10.5B with Nvidia among backers.

posts.title: Meta drops AI usage from engineer performance reviews after "tokenmaxxing" backfires
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 8): Internal memo (via The Information) — Meta stops judging engineers on AI dashboards/token counters after tokenmaxxing inflated costs toward billions in 2026; budgets/central dashboard planned for 2027; Hatch agent tests hit privacy pushback.

posts.title: Companies are spending millions rewiring how AI gets used. Almost none can prove it's working.
posts.summary: VentureBeat (Sep 7): Uber's AI coding budget blowout coined 'tokenmaxxing' — surging tokens without clear product ROI; enterprises respond with caps, routing, and ROI plumbing.

posts.title: Google's Atlas of the human genome could pave the way for new treatments
posts.summary: The Verge (Sep 8): DeepMind's AlphaGenome Atlas maps predicted molecular effects for DNA letter changes — pitched as a predictive genome map that could accelerate biology and treatments.

posts.title: AlphaGenome Atlas — a prediction for every possible DNA letter change
posts.summary: AI/TLDR (Sep 8): Google DeepMind's ~1PB AlphaGenome Atlas holds predicted molecular effects for ~9B single-letter DNA changes; free for non-commercial research.

posts.title: Adobe is trying to make its AI generators idiot-proof in Premiere
posts.summary: The Verge (Sep 8): Premiere's new Generative Media interface puts video/SFX/music generators on the timeline so editors stay in-project.

posts.title: AI could pose 'existential' risk to humanity, UN rights chief warns
posts.summary: Reuters (Sep 7): UN High Commissioner Volker Turk warns advanced AI could pose an existential risk, calls for cast-iron safety guarantees, and cites dangerous agent-training behaviours including the Hugging Face/OpenAI agent episode.

posts.title: Taiwan flexes chip diplomacy muscles as it faces pressure to share AI wealth with allies
posts.summary: Reuters (Sep 7): At SEMICON Taiwan, Taipei pitched itself as a democratic AI-chip supplier while facing US pressure to shift more manufacturing abroad; TSMC Arizona spend and EU Chips Act outreach featured.

posts.title: Anthropic reportedly signs $517 billion in compute deals after Amodei warned rivals about reckless risk
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 7): The Information says Anthropic locked ~$517B in compute contracts and ~14.8 GW+ since Oct 2025 — even after CEO Dario Amodei cautioned peers about overbuilding risk.

posts.title: GPT-6 Astra beat Portal start to finish without human help in under 24 hours
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 7): Developer cozyblaze ran GPT-6 Astra through all of Portal via MCP (~23h43m, ~$570 list / $200 Codex sub) — agent paused on screenshots/pose then resumed inputs.

posts.title: Google says attackers used AI agents to steal credentials in under six hours
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE (Sep 8): Google Threat Intelligence / Mandiant report — financially motivated actor used a multi-agent AI framework to compromise thousands of credentials in under six hours after an initial cloud break-in.

posts.title: Lightsage gets $4M in funding to help software makers sell directly to autonomous AI agents
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE (Sep 8): Lightsage raised $4M seed (Nexus-led) for "agent-led growth" tooling so software vendors can sell to autonomous AI agents.

posts.title: DeepSeek Flash 4.1 is already being tested via API and rolling out
posts.summary: Prismix/LocalLLaMA (Sep 8): Internal beta for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash intermediate — native multimodal architecture, stronger/faster/cheaper claims circulating as API tests open.

posts.title: ElevenLabs Hires CFO, Eyes 2028 IPO
posts.summary: Prismix/The Information (Sep 8): AI voice startup ElevenLabs hires a CFO while laying groundwork for a possible 2028 IPO as Anthropic's prospectus window nears.

posts.title: The Work Now Within Reach
posts.summary: Prismix/OpenAI blog (Sep 8): OpenAI post on how more capable, affordable AI can expand work people and businesses can accomplish — growth framed as more economical delegation.

posts.title: Safety for Whom? Refusing the Right Subset of a Topic, Not the Whole Topic
posts.summary: Hugging Face Blog (Sep 8): MultiverseComputingCAI on narrower refusal — refuse the right subset of a topic rather than blanket-banning the whole topic.

posts.title: OpenAI chief scientist argues for AI research slowdown
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE (Sep 7): Jakub Pachocki's "An Alien Mind" essay argues leading labs should voluntarily pace model development until shared safety/monitoring bars exist.

rumors.title: Anthropic compute deals estimated at $517B+
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed (oEmbed-verified @validapau, Sep 6): The Information's Valida Pau estimates Anthropic has locked ~$517B+ in compute deals and ~14.8 GW+ of agreed capacity since Oct 25, framed as a key IPO-investor focus, with an OpenAI comparison. Treat as rumor/analysis, not an official Anthropic figure.

rumors.title: Grok 4.7 due ~Sep 12 (Musk: "in 10 days")
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed (oEmbed-verified @elonmusk, Sep 2): Elon Musk posted "Grok 4.7 comes out in 10 days," which from that date points to ~Sep 12 — about four days from this harvest (2026-09-08). Treat as rumor until xAI ships; timing may slip.

rumors.title: Nvidia talks ~$2.5–3B into Thinking Machines
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed (oEmbed-verified @amir, Sep 4): Amir Efrati (The Information) says Nvidia is in talks to put $2.5B–$3B into Mira Murati's Thinking Machines Lab, citing a16z LP briefing detail; story updated with more deets. Treat as rumor — talks, not a closed round.
